summary: v71 tested: admin invite/resend email_error, forgot-password role highlight, /login role persistence + partner field alignment, partner referral links (public lookup, tagged self-fill registrations, partner portal referral box, /register?partner banner + submit). Backend 14/14 new tests pass + test_v67 regression 33/33. Frontend: 4 of 5 features pass; partner sign-in field alignment still broken (inputs 486px vs cards 440px). Also found /register start form wipes user input typed in the first ~1-2s after load.

minor.issue: When RESEND_API_KEY is set but fallback relay (EMAIL_KEY) path is used and fails, LAST_ERROR is never set -> email_error would be empty string. Only Resend path and 'no key' path populate it.
Module-level dict, unbounded growth and per-process; fine for same-request use but never pruned.

ui_bugs.issue: NOT FIXED: with role=partner, signin-e-email/password/submit/register-btn are 486px wide vs role cards 440px (escrow: 489px). On mobile 390px viewport inputs are 486px and get clipped off-screen. RCA: inner fields container `<div style={{display:'grid', gap:'14px'}}>` has an implicit auto column which grows to min-content of the nowrap button text 'Register as a partner — onboard suppliers & earn commission' (and escrow equivalent). Fix: add gridTemplateColumns:'minmax(0,1fr)' to that grid (or allow white-space:normal on signin-register-btn).

Values typed into reg-start-email/company within ~1-2s of page load are wiped (page subtree re-mounts; public/partner is fetched twice). Then clicking submit silently does nothing because submit() does `if (!email) return;` without any toast. Reproduced 2/2 times; works if user waits ~1s. Same 'state reset race' previously noted on /login and /partner/join - looks app-wide (route remount after first paint). Also add a toast/required validation when email is empty.

issues: Toast shows raw provider JSON ({"message":...,"name":"validation_error","statusCode":422}); consider parsing `message` from Resend response for a cleaner reason.

passed_tests: POST /admin/agents/invite and /resend return email_error with Resend 422 reason for example.com; resend on approved -> 409
Admin UI Resend toast: 'Invitation email did not send. Email provider said (422): ...'
/forgot-password: admin click highlights only forgot-portal-admin; staff only staff; partner only partner
/login: clicking signin-role-partner immediately after load updates URL to ?role=partner; reload keeps Partner selected
POST /registrations with partner_code -> partner_id/partner_code/partner_access=self_fill/partner_source=link/invited_by_partner_id; invalid/non-approved code -> untagged
Tagged registration appears in GET /agents/me/suppliers with partner_access self_fill; supplier resume works
Partner portal ps-referral, ps-referral-link = origin/register?partner=PT-0001, Copy -> 'Link copied' + clipboard correct, WhatsApp wa.me href correct
/register?partner=PT-0001 shows reg-partner-banner with name+code; submit creates tagged registration (self_fill, link) and resume page shows partner box
Invalid ?partner code shows no banner and clears localStorage
